description: This file defines the interface for a STUN client within the 'stun' namespace, including classes, enums, and functions related to STUN message creation, encoding, decoding, and network access type discovery. It includes class declarations for message handling, network communication, and address management, specifically for the NetworkManagerStunClient component.

classes.name: stun::attribute
classes.description: Represents a STUN attribute with type, length, and value.

classes.name: stun::attributes::address
classes.description: Base class for address attributes, encapsulating sockaddr_storage.

classes.name: stun::attributes::mapped_address
classes.description: Derived class representing a mapped address attribute.

classes.name: stun::attributes::source_address
classes.description: Derived class representing a source address attribute.

classes.name: stun::attributes::changed_address
classes.description: Derived class representing a changed address attribute.

classes.name: stun::message
classes.description: Represents a STUN message with header and attributes, capable of encoding and attribute lookup.

classes.name: stun::message_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating STUN messages, e.g., binding requests.

classes.name: stun::decoder
classes.description: Provides static methods to decode various parts of a STUN message from a buffer.

classes.name: stun::encoder
classes.description: Provides static methods to encode data types into a buffer.

classes.name: stun::server
classes.description: Represents a server with hostname and port.

classes.name: stun::client
classes.description: Main class for managing STUN client operations, including binding and network type discovery.

methods.name: stun::message::encode
methods.description: Encodes the message into a buffer.

methods.name: stun::message::attributes
methods.description: Returns the list of attributes in the message.

methods.name: stun::message::find_attribute
methods.description: Finds an attribute by type within the message.

methods.name: stun::message_factory::create_binding_request
methods.description: Creates a new binding request message.

methods.name: stun::decoder::decode_u16
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit unsigned integer from buffer.

methods.name: stun::decoder::decode_u32
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit unsigned integer from buffer.

methods.name: stun::decoder::decode_attr
methods.description: Decodes a STUN attribute from buffer.

methods.name: stun::decoder::decode_message
methods.description: Decodes a STUN message from buffer.

methods.name: stun::encoder::encode_u16
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit unsigned integer into buffer.

methods.name: stun::encoder::encode_u32
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit unsigned integer into buffer.

methods.name: stun::client::bind
methods.description: Performs binding to a specified hostname and port, with interface, protocol, and timeouts.

methods.name: stun::client::discover_network_access_type
methods.description: Discovers the network access type for a given server.

methods.name: stun::client::create_udp_socket
methods.description: Creates a UDP socket with specified address family.

methods.name: stun::client::send_binding_request
methods.description: Sends a binding request, optionally to a specific address.

methods.name: stun::client::send_message
methods.description: Sends a STUN message to a remote address and returns the response.
